verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides CI/CD workflow execution compatible with GitHub Actions syntax (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15), but the evidence pack contains no mention of an organization-wide dashboard or centralized cross-repo visibility into workflow runs — only per-repo Actions functionality is documented. missing for 10: org/global Actions dashboard, cross-repo run aggregation, reporting/analytics across teams, independent confirmation of org-wide visibility use.
